subject: POC plan: Stellar Solutions — proposed success criteria & timeline
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@stellarsolutions.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: POC plan: Stellar Solutions — proposed success criteria & timeline

Hi Olivia — great speaking earlier. Per our discovery call, I wanted to summarize the proposed POC structure so we can lock dates and owners. I captured the main success criteria, an evaluation plan, and a draft milestone schedule below. Please review and call out any changes.

Success criteria (proposed)
- Functional: Redwood inference integrates with your ingestion pipeline and returns responses for representative queries.
- Latency: 95th percentile inference latency <= 220ms for 1k token context on our baseline model.
- Accuracy/QA: Automated scoring on the provided evaluation set >= 88% (per the rubric we discussed).
- Stability: No sustained failures under a 5 RPS sustained load during tests (see load test plan).
- Cost target: Achieve target per-inference cost below $0.015 for typical prompt shapes.

Evaluation plan
- Dataset: You provide a 500–1k sample set of representative prompts and expected outputs (we recommend 3 example buckets: short queries, multi-turn, and long context).
- Duration: 2-week hands-on trial with two configured endpoints (one configured for quality, one for cost-optimized quantized variant).
- Metrics: latency, tokens/call, success rate, output-diff vs baseline, and human review snippets for edge cases.

Draft timeline & milestones (initial)
- Kickoff sync: Feb 18 — introductions, access checklist, SOW review, test plan. Owner: Sergio (Redwood) / Olivia (Stellar).
- Week 1 check-in: Feb 25 — initial integration results, first pass metrics, unblock list. Owner: Monica (Redwood).
- Week 2 check-in: Mar 4 — full runs, load test, initial QA scoring. Owner: Grace (Redwood).
- Final readout: Mar 6 — results, cost estimates, recommended next steps. Owner: Rishi (Redwood).

Attachments: POC_SOW_v1.pdf, access_checklist.xlsx (attached).

Immediate next steps
1) Confirm kickoff date (proposed Feb 18).
2) Counter-sign SOW or provide redlines by Feb 17 so we can reserve capacity.
3) Share sample dataset (S3 link or drive) and firewall allowlist if needed.

Let me know if you want a different cadence or owners. Happy to adjust — our goal is to make this low friction and demonstrative of production behavior.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@stellarsolutions.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC plan: Stellar Solutions — proposed success criteria & timeline

Thanks, Sergio — great recap and aligns with what we discussed. A few notes from our side:

- Kickoff: We can’t make Feb 18 due to a leadership all-hands. Can you push the kickoff to Feb 22 instead?
- Success criteria: please add "stability under load" explicitly (we need to see consistent behavior for 5–10 RPS sustained for 30 minutes).
- Dataset: We will provide ~750 sample prompts spanning three buckets (short Q/A, multi-turn support dialogs, and long-context summarization). We’ll deliver an S3 link by Feb 16.
- Network: We’ll need the IP ranges or hostnames to add to our firewall allowlist. Can Monica share the details?

I’ll look at the SOW tonight and share redlines if any. If you can confirm the Feb 22 kickoff and the updated criteria, we’ll move forward.

Best,
Olivia Barnes
Head of AI, Stellar Solutions
olivia@stellarsolutions.com
+1 415 555 0133

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC plan: Stellar Solutions — proposed success criteria & timeline (access notes)

Hi all — quick technical notes for Olivia and the Stellar infra team:

- Firewall/IPs: For hosted Redwood endpoints we will provide a small set of egress IPs to allowlist. See attached access_checklist_v2.xlsx (tab: network). The ranges are 34.210.12.0/24 and 34.210.13.0/24 (subject to change; we'll confirm 24 hours before kickoff).
- Auth: We prefer a short-lived service account with scoped access to an S3 bucket for sample data. If Stellar prefers Drive, we can work with a share link; else S3 signed URL is ideal for larger sample sets.
- Load test window: For the stability check, suggest a 45-minute window on Week 2 where we run 5–10 RPS sustained against the quantized variant, while monitoring error rates and KV cache behavior. Please confirm a 1-hour maintenance window for that test.
- Dependencies: We’ll need the sample dataset and any custom scoring rules two full business days before the Week 2 check-in to run automated scoring.

I’ve cc'ed Grace for any model/config questions and Rishi for commercial gating.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: POC plan: Stellar Solutions — proposed success criteria & timeline

Thanks for the quick replies — Olivia, Feb 22 works for us. I updated the timeline below and incorporated the stability criterion Monica mentioned. Please see the final items and links.

Updated timeline & owners
- Kickoff sync: Feb 22 — Sergio/Olivia (30–45m) — review SOW, access, and test plan.
- Week 1 check-in: Mar 1 — Monica — integration & baseline metrics.
- Week 2 check-in + load test: Mar 8 — Grace — load/stability window + automated scoring.
- Final readout: Mar 10 — Rishi — results, cost modeling, next-step commercial proposal.

New/confirmed success criteria highlights
- Stability under a 5–10 RPS sustained window (45 minutes) with <1% error rate.
- Latency and QA thresholds as previously listed.

Immediate asks for Stellar
1) Please countersign or send SOW redlines by EOD Feb 17: https://docs.google.com/document/d/abcdef12345
2) Share sample dataset (S3 or Drive) by Feb 16.
3) Confirm allowlist completion based on the checklist attached.

HubSpot link for the deal if you need internal reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/98765

I’ll send a calendar invite for Feb 22 once we have confirmation on the SOW timing. Looking forward to getting started.

Best,
